principles.author: Motilal Oswal AMC
principles.principle: How to buy stocks which can become potential multibaggers
principles.details: The Motilal Oswal QGLP framework is a proprietary investment philosophy focused on identifying high-quality, long-term wealth creators. It stands for Quality (business & management), Growth (earnings), Longevity (of growth), and Price (fair valuation). This framework prioritizes buying high-quality businesses with durable competitive advantages at reasonable prices.
